column1: # Expected hashes of crates/rcfd-fv/tests/fractional_step.rs (ADR 0190). Columns: key, platform (any, windows, linux-x86_64), hash.
# ADR 0043 A1: the fingerprints were recorded from the code before the fix and written into the ADR before the fix.
# The Taylor-Green initial field calls the platform's libm (sin, cos), so its fingerprint differs per platform: the value recorded on Windows,
# and the x86_64 Linux value proven equal at the pre-fix code (7b2d092) and at HEAD (ADR 0137); other platforms print it and skip.
# The cavity fingerprint is the same on both, and asserted on every platform.
